name: cavemio-skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: The shape of what's coming, with one soft band of light sweeping across, and a swap that hands over to the real content without a pop.

cavemio.usage:
import { Skeleton, SkeletonSwap } from "@/components/skeleton";

<SkeletonSwap loading={!data} fallback={<><Skeleton shape="circle" /><Skeleton width="60%" /></>}>
  <Profile user={data} />
</SkeletonSwap>
cavemio.accessibility:
- Skeleton shapes are aria-hidden; SkeletonSwap announces its label and sets aria-busy.
- Reduced motion: no sweep; the content fades in.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: SkeletonSwap
props.description: – · Holds the fallback, then hands over.

useCases.title: Dashboards
useCases.description: Cards and charts while data loads.

useCases.title: Profiles
useCases.description: An avatar and two lines of text.

useCases.title: Feeds
useCases.description: Posts that arrive without shifting the page.

features.title: One sweep
features.description: A light band crosses each shape in 1.6s.

features.title: Hand-over
features.description: SkeletonSwap crossfades to content through a blur (300ms).

features.title: No jump
features.description: The box eases between the skeleton's height and the content's.

features.title: Shapes
features.description: line, circle and block with any size.

states.title: waiting
states.description: Muted shapes with a sweep (1.6s loop).

states.title: arriving
states.description: Content rises 4px out of a 4px blur (300–420ms); height eases (360ms).
